_comment: Neutral worked example. Copy per job, point FMB_JOB at it. Paths: absolute, ~, $FMB_DATA, or relative to this file. demo/make_demo.py creates every $FMB_DATA/demo file so the dry runs build with no missing inputs.
gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
